scenes.headline: How a Gated DeltaNet hybrid remembers
scenes.sub: A fixed memory on three layers in four, full attention on the fourth
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ripley! This is the layer that fills three slots in four of Qwen's recent models.

states.term: Hybrid: recurrent layers plus a few attention layers
states.say: Forty-eight keep a fixed memory. Sixteen are ordinary attention, and their cache grows with every token.

scenes.title: The gated delta rule
scenes.text: S_t = S_t-1 α (I - β k kᵀ) + β v kᵀ
scenes.say: Each head keeps one matrix, the state. Every token edits it.

parts.say: Alpha decays the whole state. Near zero, it wipes the memory.

parts.note: erase what was stored along the key
parts.say: Then it reads what the state holds for this key, and takes it out.

parts.note: write the new value along the key
parts.say: And writes the new value in its place. Beta sets how hard.

stations.label: Erase
stations.sub: remove the old value for k

steps.say: Follow one token through one head. It brings a query, a key, a value and two gates.

steps.term: Delta rule: overwrite the slot, don't pile on
steps.say: Then the erase. A repeated key replaces its value instead of blending with it.
The query reads the result with one product. Same cost at any length.
The paper's block. Short convolutions on the query, key and value, a norm on the keys, and a gate on the output.

steps.caption: the paper's hybrids mix in sliding-window attention
steps.say: Its hybrids paired the layer with windowed attention. Production models chose full attention instead.
So a block is three recurrent layers and one attention layer, sixteen times over.
Only the attention layer keeps a cache that grows. It does the exact lookups a summary cannot.

scenes.quote: because a finite state cannot reproduce exact token-level retrieval no matter how well it is gated
scenes.say: One layer in four stays global, because a finite state cannot reproduce exact token-level retrieval no matter how well it is gated.

scenes.title: Qwen3.8-27B cache at 262,144 tokens, GB
scenes.note: the 48 recurrent states add 144 MiB, at any length
scenes.say: At a quarter of a million tokens, the sixteen attention layers hold seventeen gigabytes. All sixty-four would hold almost seventy.

scenes.label: Qwen3.5-9B on AIME 2026 when its state drops from FP32 to BF16
scenes.say: The fixed part is small, and fragile. Store it in sixteen-bit floats and the score falls fifteen points.

scenes.text: Three layers keep a cheap, editable memory; the fourth keeps everything, for exact recall.
scenes.say: Three layers keep a cheap memory they can edit. The fourth keeps everything, for exact recall.

recap: Decay, erase, write: one matrix per head
Constant cost per token, at any length
One attention layer in four for exact lookup
